title: A local you met offers to change money
scenario: Someone friendly you met at your accommodation offers to exchange your currency at a much better rate than any exchange office nearby, right there on the street.

answers.A: Exchange a small amount first to test it.
answers.B: Exchange your full remaining cash since the rate is so much better.
answers.C: Politely decline and use a licensed exchange office or your bank card instead.

explanation: Street exchange offers that beat every licensed office are typically funded by counterfeit notes or short-counting, and the friendliness is part of lowering your guard.
proTip: A rate too good for a licensed office to match usually isn't real money changing hands.
